Pełzucki 1896 — the red numbers' sheet working page

Each card is a red ink cluster inside your region. The red numbers are single, low figures without a hyphen (the editor's observation; the areas stand in black, so these are not area pairs) - read the value as written, and note what it sits beside if you can. Enter saves; Unsure (Ctrl+Enter) flags a doubtful card, empty or not. Export any time.

The blue box marks the machine's cluster - drag inside it to move it, an edge to move that edge, a corner for both (the cursor shows which). Hide box (H) shows the crop bare, from anywhere; the setting stays. A darker blue box means you adjusted it.
